doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: Joe Rene the drummer, his death, and other drummers
summary: De De describes Kid Rene's brother's raised snare-drum style and his reported death from food poisoning, then other drummers.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Rene had a style of drummer, his brother though, a drummer. The snare drummer would sit up like this one. That's what he played. Yeah. If he's sitting down like I'm sitting here, that's why he played the snare drum up here. And his hands were up. He played on those parades and put those drums up. That's why he played, sitting down. That was his style of playing. That kid Rene's brother.
I heard him on the record, never did see him, I wouldn't work from him. He's a fine fella, he's all right.

I got along with him, I'm not speaking. He's still living, isn't he? No, he died. Joe? Yeah. Joe died, ooh, Joe died, yeah. Both of them were? Seven years back, yeah, both then. Well I guess I knew it. Joe died after, after, after, after, in here, in here.
I thought, I was thinking Joe was still living.
No, no, no, Joe died, no. In other words he's claiming tommene poison. Well I forgot of him, wasn't he? Yeah.
Did he die after his brother Henry?
Oh he died after Henry, yeah, from tommene poison, food, food poison.
That's what I was told. Yes, yes indeed. Put him down.
Never did see him, I heard that he. He was such a big eater.
Yeah, I heard you big eater.
I heard he joined church or something.

Yeah and all that, but he died from food poisoning they claim. Yeah. Did he give up that? When some food, if not, I ain't say it, but I mean it's truly the truth. Yeah. When food was dumped, put out on the dump. That's where he. Oh. Can stuff, and I believe he got a hold of that. Oh no. He died from, what they call, tomane poison, food poison. That's what I understood now. That's what they had said. He lived back that way sometime during that time.
Yes. Who were some of the other good drummers you worked with that you liked?
Well, like I said, the past, the first man I started with, he was a good drummer. The whole time, oh yeah, the whole time. He used overhead pedals at the time though.
Oh yes, I've heard of that. Yeah.
The only one I know. Then after that, everybody was drumming. I don't know.
Yes, a lot of them. There's so many of them.
